description: Implementation of a media codec wrapper for Android, managing media codec buffers, surface setting, and output buffer release logic within Chromium's media GPU component.

classes.name: CodecWrapperImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing media codec buffers, surface, and state.

classes.name: CodecOutputBuffer
classes.description: Represents an output buffer from the media codec, with methods to release or render it.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::TakeCodecSurfacePair
methods.description: Returns the current codec surface pair and discards output buffers.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::IsFlushed
methods.description: Checks if the codec is in the flushed state.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::IsDraining
methods.description: Checks if the codec is in the draining state.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::IsDrained
methods.description: Checks if the codec is in the drained state.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::HasUnreleasedOutputBuffers
methods.description: Returns true if there are unreleased output buffers.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::DiscardOutputBuffers
methods.description: Discards all current output buffers.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::Flush
methods.description: Flushes the codec, resetting buffer states.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::QueueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::DequeueOutputBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues an output buffer, handling format changes and EOS.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::SetSurface
methods.description: Sets the surface for the codec.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::SurfaceBundle
methods.description: Returns the current surface bundle.

methods.name: CodecWrapperImpl::ReleaseCodecOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer, optionally rendering it.

methods.name: CodecWrapper::CodecWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec wrapper with surface, callback, and size.

methods.name: CodecWrapper::~CodecWrapper
methods.description: Destructor ensuring the codec surface pair has been taken.

methods.name: CodecWrapper::TakeCodecSurfacePair
methods.description: Returns the current codec surface pair.

methods.description: Checks if there are unreleased output buffers.
